# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use the repository's private GitHub security advisory flow or contact the maintainers through the private contact method listed on the repository page.

Include the affected version or commit, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation. Please allow maintainers reasonable time to investigate and coordinate a fix before public disclosure.

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the default branch and the latest released version unless the repository documents a narrower support policy.
